senses.gloss:
--(Maurvyas-वि। प्।) succeeded the Nandas. The पुराण speaks of ten kings ruling for १३७ (१७३ वि। प्।) years. Only nine kings are mentioned from Candragupta to बृहद्रथ; were succeeded by the शुन्गस्.
1: भा. XII. 1. १२ and १५; Br. III. ७४. १४९; वा. ९९. ३३६; Vi. IV. २४. २७, ३२-3.
म्।प्। men- tions शतधन्व, बृहद्रथ, शक and his grandson दश- ratha and his son; the first four are missing.
2: M. २७२. २२, २६.
